ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, OC is the bisector of $\angle AOB$, and $\angle COD=20^\circ$. If $\angle AOD=30^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle COD=20^\circ$ and $\angle AOD=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOC=\angle COD+\angle AOD=20^\circ+30^\circ=50^\circ$,\\
Since OC is the bisector of $\angle AOB$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOB=2\angle AOC=\boxed{100^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, four rays are emitted from the same point O: OA is horizontal to the right, OB is oblique to the upper left, OC is located between OA and OB and is closer to the middle, and OD is located between OA and OC.
